title: MIMO Fading Channel
text: Filter input signal through MIMO multipath fading channel, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Specify spatial correlation} sets Spatial correlation mode; {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the option to inherit the sample rate, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the input signal sample rate, {Discrete path delays (s)} sets the delays for each discrete path, {Average path gains (dB)} sets the average gain for each discrete path, {Normalize average path gains to 0 dB} sets the option to normalize average path gains, {Fading distribution}, {K-factors} sets the k-factor of Rician fading channel, {LOS path Doppler shifts (Hz)} sets the doppler shifts for line-of-sight, {LOS path initial phases (rad)} sets the initial phases for line-of-sight, {Maximum Doppler shift (Hz)} sets the maximum Doppler shift for all channel, {Doppler spectrum}, {Number of transmit antennas}, {Number of receive antennas}, {Transmit spatial correlation} sets the spatial correlation of transmitter, {Receive spatial correlation} sets the spatial correlation of receiver {Combined spatial correlation}, {Normalize outputs by number of receive antennas} sets the normalize channel output, {Simulate using} sets the compilation type Interpreted, {Antenna selection scheme}, {Technique for generating fading samples} sets the channel modeling technique Filtered Gaussian, {Number of sinusoids}, {Initial time source} sets the source of initial time, {Initial time (s)} sets the initial time offset, {Initial seed} sets the random number generator initial seed, {Output channel path gains} sets the option to output channel path gains, {Channel visualization} selects the channel visualization, {Antenna pair to display} sets the transmit-receive antenna pair to display, {Percentage of samples to display} and {Path for Doppler spectrum display} sets the path for which Doppler spectrum. Values come from the instance.
